Francis, named in-game as Abducted Nobleman, can be found in the Nautiloid Wreck during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Before his abduction by mind flayers, Francis was a wealthy pottery merchant. His corpse is strewn among the Nautiloid debris near the Intellect Devourers at X: 230 Y: 271.

Loot

  • Silver Locket

Speak with Dead

Francis' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Francis... merchant... selling pottery...
  • How did you die?
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Fire... screaming... then crunch. Nothing...
  • What happened to you?
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Guiding my cart... shadow fell... tentacle grabbed me... Took me here... put something in my eye...
      • Do you know why any of us were taken?
        • Abducted Nobleman
          No... took everyone... peasants... lords... took them all...
      • They put something in my eye too. Can we get rid of it?
        • Abducted Nobleman
          Find healer...or die... it'll leave...
  • Do you have anything valuable?
    • Abducted Nobleman
      They took me... took everything...

Only after asking at least one other question:

  • [CLERIC] [PALADIN] Are there any rites you'd like performed over your body?  +1  +1
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Not from your cursed god...
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Too late now...
  • [BARD] Would you like me to craft you a stunning tale? Lock your memory in legend forever?  +1  +1
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Doesn't matter... nothing matters...
  • [DRUID] [RANGER] Your body will attract scavengers. Should I bury you?  +1  +1
    • Abducted Nobleman
      Let them come...
